parameters.name: hcn_nmr.inp
parameters.content:
! PBE0 def2-TZVP RKS TightSCF NoAutoStart
%maxcore 192
%scf
  MaxIter 200
  AutoTRAH false
end
* xyzfile 0 1 hcn.xyz
%eprnmr
  Ori = GIAO
  Nuclei = all
  NMRShielding 2
end

entries.purpose: fixed initial HCN geometry for GIAO shielding

goal_giao_nuclear_shielding.gap: Raw ORCA NMR output must be inspected before authoring the shielding parser.

goal_shielding_tensor_and_isotropic.gap: Tensor extraction depends on the completed ORCA output format.

goal_isotropic_trace_consistency.gap: Trace consistency must be computed from parsed tensors after the ORCA run.

goal_deliver_artifacts.gap: Final input, geometries, raw output, script, and tables will be assembled after parsing.

goal_random_seed_record.gap: Seed 1701 must be recorded in the final report; no stochastic ORCA step is used.

goal_shielding_constants_not_chemical_sh.gap: Final wording must explicitly retain shielding constants and avoid chemical-shift conversion.

proposal.reason: Initial plan: resolve and prepare the HCN geometry, write an explicit PBE0/def2-TZVP RKS gas-phase ORCA NMR input with GIAO all-nuclei shielding, then run it. Parsing and report-goal bindings are deferred until the actual ORCA output format is inspected, avoiding an invented parser.
